_comment: Consumer (retail) lending — composes ON TOP of the base lending profile. A retail credit product automatically compiles consumer-duty, affordability, credit-risk, data and model-risk controls a wholesale product never sees.

medium._pa1_comment: rc.38 (flow-plan Phase 4.6) — a retail credit product's conduct objection belongs at permission-to-develop, beside the target-market analysis it reads, not at permission-to-launch beside the disclosures it would then send back.
